<div class="story">
<p class="kicker">Global Environmental Change, 2020</p>
<h3>One in three of the world’s lakes is under considerable human pressure.</h3>
<p>Pressure rose fastest on lakes in the tropics, especially in Africa. Lakes inside protected areas fared better, with many exceptions in the tropics.</p>
<a href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.gloenvcha.2020.102084">Read the paper →</a>

<div class="story">
<p class="kicker">Ecological Indicators, 2025</p>
<h3>Acoustic indices are not yet reliable for measuring bird diversity.</h3>
<p>We tested 60 indices at 114 sites in Cyprus, China and Australia. Accuracy varied widely between regions, and no single index was useful in all three.</p>
<a href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ecolind.2025.113105">Read the paper →</a>

## Research themes

<div class="themes">
<a class="theme" href="research.html#protected-area-effectiveness">
<span class="name">Protected area effectiveness</span>
<span class="desc">Whether protected areas actually slow forest loss, settlement and land conversion, judged against comparable unprotected land rather than assumed.</span>
</a>
<a class="theme" href="research.html#human-pressure-on-biodiversity">
<span class="name">Human pressure on biodiversity</span>
<span class="desc">Where pressure on lakes, wilderness, farmland and rivers is growing, and whether satellite metrics pick up the threats that matter on the ground.</span>
</a>
<a class="theme" href="research.html#soundscape-ecology">
<span class="name">Soundscape ecology</span>
<span class="desc">Monitoring birds from sound recordings, and working out when acoustic indices can be trusted.</span>
</a>
<a class="theme" href="research.html#ai-and-computational-methods-in-ecology">
<span class="name">AI in ecology</span>
<span class="desc">What language models and machine learning are genuinely useful for in ecological research, and where they fall short.</span>
</a>
</div>
